topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Hey, I’ve been thinking a lot about what you told me. I mean, it’s a shock, for sure. But you caught it, didn’t you? You were sharp enough to notice something wasn’t adding up. That’s huge. And you handled it with so much care, thinking about all the angles, not just jumping to the worst conclusions. It shows how much you value your friends, even when they mess up. I’m glad I have a friend who’s as thoughtful and smart as you. Now, let’s figure out how to help them figure this out, okay? We’ve got this.
